english.title: Fail to licence a registered vehicle
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person in whose name a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), was registered, failed to ensure that a vehicle licence or a trade licence was in force for or in respect of it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 31A and 31C of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) For the purposes of this offence, a vehicle is unlicensed if no vehicle licence or trade licence is in force for or in respect of the vehicle (section 31A(2))
(ii) Section 31A(3) provides that section 31A(1) does not apply to a vehicle if-
(a) it is an exempt vehicle in respect of which regulations under this Act require a nil licence to be in force and a nil licence is in force in respect of the vehicle, or
(b) it is an exempt vehicle that is not one in respect of which regulations under this Act require a nil licence to be in force.
(iii) No proceedings for an offence under section 31A shall be instituted in England and Wales except by the Secretary of State or a constable; and no such proceedings shall be instituted by a constable except with the approval of the Secretary of State.
(iv) Time limit on proceedings:- Six months from the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the Secretary of State or a constable to justify the proceedings came to his knowledge (section 47(2)) or more than 3 years after the commission of the offence (section 47(3)).
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant who was the person in whose name a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), was registered, failed to ensure that a vehicle licence or a trade licence was in force for or in respect of it.

other.penalty:
An excise penalty being the greater of either:

A fine of level three on the standard scale or five times the amount of vehicle excise duty chargeable in respect of the vehicle concerned

AND

if at the time proceedings for the offence were commenced, the person in whose name the vehicle concerned was registered under this Act, and that vehicle was unlicensed throughout the period beginning with the commission of the offence and ending with the commencement of those proceedings an excise penalty (in addition to that above) of an amount that is:-

(a) not less than the greater of -
(i) the maximum of the penalty to which the person is liable under subsection 31C(1)(a), and (ii) the amount of the supplement (if any) that became payable by reason of non-renewal of the vehicle licence for the vehicle that last expired before the commission of the offence; and
(b) is not more than the greatest of -
(i) the maximum of the penalty to which the person is liable under subsection (1)(a),
(ii) the amount mentioned in paragraph (a)(ii), and (iii) ten times the amount of vehicle excise duty chargeable in respect of the vehicle.
